item.title: Summer I and III Student Course Evaluations Now Open
item.description: Date: Friday, July 31, 2026 (all day) - Summer I and III student course evaluations are now open. The evaluation period is from 7/31 through 8/15. Your feedback is very important to the Institute, the five schools, and their departments, so please complete evaluation surveys for all your courses! Evaluations will be available through Saturday, August 15, 2026.

item.title: Updates around campus
item.description: You may start to notice some new signs and updates to signage around campus! We’re making a few changes to help create a more welcoming, clear, and easy-to-navigate environment for everyone in our community. As the updates roll out, you may see new signs popping up or some familiar ones being replaced. We’re excited for you to see the changes and appreciate your patience as we work to give our campus a fresh new look! Union Lots: 30-minute parking is available for short-term visits. Sherry Road…

item.title: WITS Feeder Workshop on Quantum Machine Learning
item.description: Lally will host the WITS Feeder Workshop on Quantum Machine Learning, bringing together researchers and industry leaders to explore the intersection of quantum computing, AI, and real-world decision-making. Through research presentations, industry perspectives, demonstrations, and a featured panel, the workshop will examine emerging applications and their implications for business, science, and government.

item.title: Accepting parcels/mail for 2026 fall semester incoming students.
item.description: The Student Mail Center will accept and hold packages for on-campus residents. Once processed, the student will receive an email with pickup instructions at a parcel locker or the service counter. Additional address and shipping information can be found on the RPI Student Mail Center’s website.

item.title: The Countdown Is On! RPI’s Annual Staff Awards Are Almost Here
item.description: The countdown is on! Soon, you’ll have the opportunity to celebrate the people and teams who help RPI thrive through RPI’s Annual Staff Awards Program. Starting August 17, you’ll have the opportunity to nominate a colleague or team whose contributions, creativity, dedication, and impact truly stand out.

item.title: Updates to the student experience
item.description:
As we prepare for the year ahead, you are invited to join us for a campus-wide conversation about updates designed to support and strengthen the student experience on August 19 from 9–11 a.m. at CBIS, Auditorium.

For information about sharing your news or events, or to change your subscription settings, visit morningmail.rpi.edu.
